name: cookies-kitchen
description: Chrome/Edge/Brave/Firefox extension (MV3) to export and import browser cookies as JSON.

scripts.build:chromium: npm run build:css && node build.mjs chromium
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:css && node build.mjs firefox
scripts.build:safari: npm run build:css && node build.mjs safari
scripts.build: npm run build:css && node build.mjs all
